title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Supabase raises $150M and acquires Turso to give every AI agent its own database (Oct 2-4)
bullets.summary: Supabase is buying Turso (SQLite-based) to offer per-agent databases at scale, betting the backend becomes the agent battleground.
bullets.how: The Construct: per-agent isolated SQLite/Postgres stores are a clean pattern for agent memory and state instead of shared files. PRAGMA: a concrete backend recommendation for client agent builds. Brand 9: no direct use.

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.289 (Oct 4) adds agent.spawn for teammates and agent-state support; 2.1.288 adds MCP OAuth re-auth prompts
bullets.summary: Plugin, terminal and shell-safety fixes plus new teammate-spawning and agent state primitives; MCP servers requesting extra OAuth scope now trigger re-authentication.
bullets.how: The Construct: agent.spawn maps onto our multi-agent swarm pattern, and the re-auth behavior affects any MCP connector with scoped OAuth. PRAGMA: sharper multi-agent story for client Claude Code deployments.

bullets.title: AWS MCP Server expands to six more regions (Oct 2)
bullets.summary: The managed AWS MCP Server, part of the Agent Toolkit for AWS, is now in Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Ireland, London and Oregon for lower latency and data residency.
bullets.how: PRAGMA: a managed MCP endpoint is a ready option for client infra-automation agents with residency needs. The Construct and Brand 9: no direct use unless we host on AWS.

bullets.title: arXiv 2610.02351 DeReAct: decomposed reasoning and acting with external gating policies
bullets.summary: Proposes a modular agent design where separate gating policies validate actions and control completion, aimed at more reliable agents.
bullets.how: The Construct: maps directly to our verify-before-claiming and gate-the-output discipline; external gates beat self-reported completion. PRAGMA: a citable framing for reliability-focused client pitches.

bullets.title: arXiv 2610.02687 GraphMemory: graph-based structured memory for token-efficient continual learning
bullets.summary: Decouples memory from context with a graph that accumulates, refines and connects reusable strategies while cutting token cost.
bullets.how: The Construct: a model for evolving the PRAXIS inbox into linked, reusable strategies rather than flat logs. PRAGMA: memory architecture talking point.

praxis_lesson: Reliable agents come from structure outside the model: per-agent state (Turso/Supabase), spawned teammates (agent.spawn) and external gates (DeReAct) all move correctness out of the prompt and into the architecture. Give each Construct agent its own isolated store and a gate that verifies before it reports done.
